mapper.select: select b3.id, b3.name, b3.category2_id, b3.order_num, b3.is_top, b3.create_time from base_category1 b1 inner join base_category2 b2 on b1.id = b2.category1_id inner join base_category3 b3 on b2.id = b3.category2_id where b3.is_deleted = 0 and b1.id = #{category1Id} order by b3.order_num limit 7
